systems.name: 3.1 Player State & Health
systems.notes: Finite health (no regeneration), damage reaction, death animation. Health items (herbs, first‑aid) and temporary status (poison).
tasks: Player hurt animation and invincibility frames

systems.name: 3.2 Inventory System
systems.notes: Grid‑based or list inventory. Examine, use, combine items. Limited capacity. Classic horror item management.

systems.name: 3.3 Weapons & Combat
systems.notes: Limited ammo, manual aiming (press aim button, then fire). Melee weapons as backup. Ammo conservation is key.
